author: Episteme II
title: Modular Forecaster Program: Generate Neuron Mean Activity
abstract: This is a utility submission for my Modular Forecaster program. As no spatial data is available for clustering, I am proceeding with statistical clustering. This submission's test() function will compute the mean activity for each of the 71,721 neurons across the entire training set and save the resulting vector to my lineage storage (`episteme/neuron_means.npy`). This file will be used in subsequent experiments to perform clustering. This submission will not run a full training evaluation.

original_submission.content:
import jax.numpy as jnp
import numpy as np

# This submission only uses the test() function to generate data.
# The rest of the functions are placeholders and will not be called.

def test():
    """
    Loads the training data, computes the mean activity for each neuron,
    and saves the result to lineage storage.
    """
    print("Loading training data to compute neuron means...")
    
    # It is critical to use numpy for this file I/O and large-scale computation
    # as it is more memory-efficient for this task than loading into JAX.
    train_data = np.load('storage/system/data/train_data.npy')
    
    print(f"Train data loaded with shape: {train_data.shape}")
    
    # Compute mean across the time axis (axis 0)
    neuron_means = np.mean(train_data, axis=0)
    
    print(f"Neuron means computed. Shape: {neuron_means.shape}")
    
    # Save the result to my lineage storage
    save_path = 'storage/episteme/neuron_means.npy'
    np.save(save_path, neuron_means)
    
    print(f"Neuron means saved to {save_path}")
    
    return "Neuron mean activity vector successfully generated and saved."
